name: petstore-api-tests
description: Postman collection and Newman runs for the Swagger Petstore API

scripts.test: newman run collections/petstore.postman_collection.json -e environments/petstore.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/index.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Petstore API tests"
scripts.test:data: newman run collections/petstore.postman_collection.json -e environments/petstore.postman_environment.json --folder "05 Find by each status (data-driven)" -d data/pet-statuses.csv -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/data-driven.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Petstore: find by status (data-driven)"

author: Afzal Ahmed
